aggregate per range using FILTER clause
optimized_sql:
WITH filtered_sales AS (
    SELECT ss_quantity, ss_ext_tax, ss_net_paid_inc_tax
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20
       OR ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40
       OR ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60
       OR ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80
       OR ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100
),
sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20) AS cnt_b1,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20) AS ext_avg_b1,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20) AS net_avg_b1,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40) AS cnt_b2,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40) AS ext_avg_b2,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40) AS net_avg_b2,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60) AS cnt_b3,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60) AS ext_avg_b3,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60) AS net_avg_b3,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80) AS cnt_b4,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80) AS ext_avg_b4,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80) AS net_avg_b4,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100) AS cnt_b5,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100) AS ext_avg_b5,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100) AS net_avg_b5
    FROM filtered_sales
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN cnt_b1 > 1071 THEN ext_avg_b1 ELSE net_avg_b1 END AS bucket1,
    CASE WHEN cnt_b2 > 39161 THEN ext_avg_b2 ELSE net_avg_b2 END AS bucket2,
    CASE WHEN cnt_b3 > 29434 THEN ext_avg_b3 ELSE net_avg_b3 END AS bucket3,
    CASE WHEN cnt_b4 > 6568 THEN ext_avg_b4 ELSE net_avg_b4 END AS bucket4,
    CASE WHEN cnt_b5 > 21216 THEN ext_avg_b5 ELSE net_avg_b5 END AS bucket5
FROM sales_agg
JOIN reason ON reason.r_reason_sk = 1
